notes.title: New game
notes.content:
hi guys, thanks for playng "Fighting box", i'm working on a new game "Get ready!".Try beta version for free on itch.io
https://artur-rezende.itch.io/get-ready

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
- new score with record
- new music
- added random coins on the ring to get points
- added medic item to recover energy bar
- after level 4, the fight can run into a cage
- improvements on physics
- improvements on ambient designs
- the game has become a bit lighter
